title: Weekly lead story
description: The homepage's lead story for one ISO week: which BIP, what kind of story, a headline and a two-sentence lead (reviewed text), the sources it rests on, and tile keys whose numbers the site computes from data. The weekly digest job drafts it as a pull request; merging approves it. weekly/<YYYY>-W<ww>.yaml.

lead.description: Two sentences. Avoid typed numbers; the tiles carry them.

link.description: The secondary button: the thread or pull request the story is about.

tiles.description: Up to four of: status_age, open_work, road_gap, pr_age:<GitHub PR url>, implementation:<claim id>.

sources.description: Claim ids the story rests on.
